programs.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays
programs.desc: Gather around the table and prepare to give thanks! Rachael shows how to make a tender and crispy smoked turkey, seasoned with herbs and spices and served with chestnut and sausage stuffing.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays
programs.sub_title: Roasted Garlic And Rosemary Prime Rib
programs.desc: Rachael shows how to make an impressive holiday meal that will make your guests feel like VIPs with her recipe for roasted garlic and rosemary prime rib, which she serves with her mother's special sauce.

programs.title: Masterchef Australia
programs.desc: The judges' give the top three a break in round one by facing off in a mystery box cook, before going head-to-head with the Semi-Finalists in a relay.

programs.title: 1,000 Ways To Dine
programs.desc: Dining without wi-fi facilities might be too much for some people, but anyone wanting to unleash their wild side should join host Michael Yo for a journey to some far-out eating places.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes S1E3 -Pork Chops With Twice-Cooked Potatoes
programs.desc: Rachael cooks up pork loin chops with sweet onions and apples, serving it with twice-baked potatoes topped with sour cream and chives - all in minutes.

programs.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
programs.desc: Actor and family friend Jeremy Sisto joins Rachael in her Tuscan kitchen to learn how to make hunter's chicken, known in Italy as cacciatore, served with generous helpings of bruschetta.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Pantoh is a Taiwanese dining experience where guests enjoy exquisite dishes in open-air venues. Chef Ah-yong showcases an emblematic dish of pantoh cuisine: calamari, sea snail, and leek soup.

programs.title: Jason's Table: Masterful Dishes
programs.desc: Taiwanese cuisine boasts wide variations of chicken soup, and Chef A-lin has a special recipe. Learn more about how Chef A-lin creates the most complex flavor with the most elegant approach.

programs.title: Global Soul Kitchen
programs.desc: Chef Deborah VanTrece brings a Southern twist to a traditional recipe by adding bacon, lettuce, and tomato to the Dutch Baby 'pancake', and serves it alongside a colourful asparagus and radish salad.

programs.title: Theresa Caputo: Raising Spirits
programs.sub_title: Beyond The Readings: Restoring The Faith
programs.desc: With the power of spirit behind Theresa, her journey giving the ultimate gift of peace continues. A touching follow-up message from a podcast reading confirms Theresa's lasting impact on those in need.

programs.title: Our Dead Husband
programs.desc: When Kris discovers her husband Ritchie shot dead in their home, she assumes it has to do with his work in high-level intelligence. But she then learns that his missions were a cover for a secret family.

programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: James takes on a dying home in need of a major facelift: a 104-year-old house brought to him by a rookie flipper. With the property in dire condition, James and his team must rethink the layout.
